_universal_rule: Always perform a small tank-mix compatibility test before any new combination. Watch for precipitation, color change, or temperature change.

_chemistry_notes.ca-phosphate: Ca²⁺ + phosphate → calcium phosphate precipitate (clogs drippers)
_chemistry_notes.ammonium-lime: Ammonium + free lime/Ca → ammonia gas loss

solu-up.notes: Acidic MAP. Caution when mixing with calcium-containing or magnesium sulphate products.

solu-map.notes: Same risks as soluMKP/soluUP. Caution with Ca and Mg. Tank-mix test first.

solu-mkp.notes: Caution when mixing with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ — run tank-mix test first.

solu-ams-premium.notes: Mixes with all water-soluble fertilizers EXCEPT calcium. DO NOT mix with pesticides.

solu-nop.notes: Generally compatible with most fertilizers. Both nitrate and chloride-free.

solu-cn.notes: Calcium is incompatible with phosphate sources and sulphate sources. Universal rule: tank-mix test before any new combination.

epso-top.notes: Any P + Ca + Mg combination is risky. Tank-mix test mandatory.

solu-npk-20-20-20.notes: Balanced NPK with chelated micros — broadly compatible. Always test new combinations.

solu-npk-12-12-36.notes: Balanced NPK with chelated micros — broadly compatible. Always test new combinations.

kalisop-fine.notes: Generally compatible. Test combinations with calcium-containing products.

kalisop-gran.notes: Generally compatible. Test combinations with calcium-containing products.
